verdict.what: a red barn with white corner trim, stone plinth and a dark slate roof, with a stepped gable front
verdict.style: rustic farmhouse / American red barn, with a stepped-gable, castle-like crest on the front
verdict.looks: Front view: a stepped white-and-red gable with crenellated white steps rising to a dark roof cap and a small chimney/cupola on top. Red-and-white checkered board pattern on the lower front, a dark wooden lintel over a central door, hanging lanterns and chains at each side, and a small balcony-like ledge. Barrels, hay bales and fence posts sit at the base on grass. Side view: long red wall with white corner pilasters, evenly spaced small white-framed windows, a grey-stone plinth, a dark grey cobble-look roof with a stepped top edge and a chimney block. Back view: a tall red gable wall with white side edges, a stepped white crest, and a dark roof cap with a small opening. Materials are wool/concrete-like red and white, dark stone-brick roof, stone base, oak and spruce accents.
verdict.summary: A readable, well-dressed red barn with a clear base, lanterns and props, but the roof reads as a flat lid sitting on top of the gable and the back and sides are plain red walls that need a little more relief before it is ready to place.
